Cantonese or Guangdong cuisine , also known as Yue cuisine ( Chinese : 廣東菜 or 粵菜 ), is the cuisine of Cantonese people , associated with the Guangdong province of China , particularly the provincial capital Guangzhou , and the surrounding regions in the Pearl River Delta including Hong Kong and Macau . [ 1 ] Strictly speaking, Cantonese cuisine is the cuisine of Guangzhou or of Cantonese speakers, but it often includes the cooking styles of all the speakers of Yue Chinese languages in Guangdong.
